name: Uno Apple tools
description: Notes, Maps, Music and Files as gateway tools, scoped per agent: each listed agent gets its own Notes folder and iCloud Drive folder. Unlisted agents get nothing.

notesAccount.description: Notes account that holds the folders. Default iCloud.

agents.description: Agent id -> what that agent may use. Agents not listed get no tools.

notesFolder.description: Name of the person's Notes folder. Unset: no apple_notes.

filesFolder.description: The person's folder inside iCloud Drive, relative (e.g. "Family Shared"). Unset: no apple_files.

maps.description: apple_maps for this agent. Default true.

music.description: apple_music for this agent. Default true.
